clips.title: The story
paras: Steelgrill's Depot is a bustling engineering workshop and repair station situated directly east of Kharanos in Dun Morogh. Overseen by Beldin Steelgrill and a crew of craftsmen, it serves as a frontline hub for vehicle maintenance, tinker supply runs, and salvage efforts.

Nestled just off the snowy road east of Kharanos, Steelgrill's Depot buzzes with the clamor of clanking metal, hissing steam vents, and the hum of experimental engines. Dwarven miners and eccentric gnome engineers gather here amid heavy machinery, mechanized walking frames, and stockpiles of raw ores hauled out from nearby quarries. With Dun Morogh facing relentless trogg disruptions and mechanical supply shortages, Beldin Steelgrill and his crew keep Alliance machinery in working order, serving as an indispensable stop for travelers seeking spare parts or technical guidance in the bitter cold.
